title: Analytics Overview
content: Build analytics overview dashboard. Traffic metrics: page views, sessions, users. Charts: line chart for trends, bar chart for comparisons. Sources: traffic source breakdown (pie chart). Top pages: table of most viewed pages. User flow: funnel visualization. Devices: mobile vs desktop split. Geography: map showing user locations. Real-time: current active users count.

variants.simple: Create analytics page with traffic and user metrics.
variants.detailed: Build analytics overview dashboard. Traffic metrics: page views, sessions, users. Charts: line chart for trends, bar chart for comparisons. Sources: traffic source breakdown (pie chart). Top pages: table of most viewed pages. User flow: funnel visualization. Devices: mobile vs desktop split. Geography: map showing user locations. Real-time: current active users count.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive analytics overview dashboard like Google Analytics. Key metrics row: Sessions, Users, Page Views, Bounce Rate, Avg Session Duration as stat cards with sparklines. Main chart: area/line chart showing primary metric over time, multiple series for comparison (current vs previous period as dashed line), zoom/pan for detailed inspection, hover shows tooltip with values. Time range selector: Today, Yesterday, Last 7/30/90 days, Custom range picker, comparison toggle. Traffic sources: pie or donut chart showing Direct, Organic Search, Social, Referral, Email, display percentages and absolute numbers. Top pages table: ranked list of pages by views, columns: Page, Views, Unique Views, Avg Time, Bounce Rate, sortable columns, link to page detail. Users section: new vs returning donut, active users line chart, user acquisition by source. Real-time panel: current active users count (updating live), pages being viewed now, geographic pins. Device breakdown: horizontal bars for Desktop, Mobile, Tablet percentages. Geographic: world map with country heatmap, country list with metrics, drill down to cities. Browser/OS: breakdown charts. Behavior flow: funnel visualization from landing to conversion. Engagement: scroll depth, click patterns if available. Segments: filter all data by segment (new users, mobile, organic). Export: CSV export, scheduled reports, custom dashboards. Loading: show progress for data-heavy queries. Empty state: show when no data for selected period.
